items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: So sure enough Ella came in and I introduced her to Chick and his wife

ctx.x: Chick Webb was a drummer, sort of a hunchback fellow, wasn't he.

Yeah, that's it, little Chick, so he played up at the Savoy. So sure enough Ella came in and I introduced her to Chick and his wife and I told her all you got to do is get her some clothes, get her a dress and have her hair fixed and she'd do the rest, so sure enough, Ella Fitzgerald come on and I used to tell everybody, well, I'm the one that give her a quarter to go out and get some coffee and hang out and wait around. I says I'm the one that discovered her, but Chick Webb was the one who developed her. Because…
That's beautiful. Because you were a musical director at the Apollo Theatre.
